About SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund
SBI Long Term Equity Fund is an
ELSS mutual fund
. The fund allocates at least 80% of its assets to equity, preference shares and fully convertible debentures. The remaining is invested in money market instruments to maintain liquidity.
The fund enjoys tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act. Investors can reduce their tax liability by up to ₹46,800. Investments in the SBI long-term fund are spread across large, small and mid-cap stocks to ensure the portfolio is well diversified. The fund has a mandatory lock-in period of 3 years.
Investment Strategy
The fund is actively managed by Dinesh Balchandran, who follows a bottom-up stock-picking approach along with fundamental analysis. The investment process involves identifying companies with strong business models and sound management. Each stock in the portfolio is selected after a deep evaluation of its financial health.
Who Should Invest In SBI Long Term Equity Fund - Direct Growth?
You should invest in the SBI long-term fund if:
-You are a first-time investor
-You are looking for tax benefits
-You want a diversified portfolio
Taxation on SBI Long Term Fund
Since equity-linked saving schemes have a lock-in period of 3 years, they are not subject to short-term capital gain (STCG). Any gains from selling the SBI long-term fund after 3 years are subject to long-term capital gain or LTCG at the rate of 12.5%.

Frequently Asked Questions for SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Growth
How do I invest in SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund?
INDmoney makes it simple to invest in the SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund. To do so, follow the steps below:
Download the INDmoney app.
Search for ‘SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund’.
Select whether you want to invest in SIP or lump sum.
Enter the amount you wish to invest.
Set up payments via bank mandate or UPI.
What is the current NAV of SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund?
The NAV of the fund today is ₹472.39. NAV or Net Asset Value is the per unit price of a mutual fund. For example, if the NAV of a fund is ₹10, it means you can get 1000 units of that mutual fund at ₹10,000.
What is the return on the fund?
SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund fund has generated a return of 2.30% in 1 year, 15.98% in 3 years, 16.35% in 5 years.
Who is the fund manager of SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund?
The fund managers are Milind Agrawal.
What is the expense ratio of the fund?
The expense ratio is 1.23%. The Expense Ratio is a fee charged for managing the fund. This includes commissions, administrative costs etc.
What is the AUM of the fund?
The AUM of the fund is ₹32300 Cr. AUM stands for Assets Under Management. It refers to the total assets managed by the fund.
What are the top holdings of SBI ELSS Tax Saver Fund?
The top 3 holdings of the fund are ICICI Bank Ltd(8.44%), HDFC Bank Ltd(7.9%), Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd(5.52%)
